order: Make the guard hook read the session's model before deciding whether to deny a tool call. The guard must enforce only for director models; every other model must stand the guard down entirely, with no partial enforcement. An undetermined model must resolve to enforce, never to stand-down, so the harness can never silently vanish for an actual director session. The guard must read only the latest non-sidechain assistant model from the transcript, using a fixed-cost tail read; sidechain entries must be skipped so a finished scout run under a different model can never be mistaken for the session's own model. The check must read the latest turn only, so a mid-session model switch is honored immediately rather than on a stale cached value. Detection must run only on the would-deny path, never adding cost to an allowed call. Update the docs to describe the new behavior exactly.
claims: Detection runs only on the would-deny path, so allowed calls pay nothing extra; measured at roughly zero milliseconds added over the existing spawn cost on an 8.8MB transcript, using a fixed-cost 256KB tail read. The guard now enforces only for director models and stands down entirely for any other model, with an undetermined model still resolving to enforce. The diff touches three files: 82 insertions, 14 deletions. Docs were updated to match.
